# Apply by slot ($SLOT$ = a/b/c).
xar_apply_blessing_effect = {
	if = { limit = { global_var:xa_bless_$SLOT$ = 0 } add_gold = 50
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_selected_bless_rarity value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:xa_bless_$SLOT$ = 1 } add_gold = 100
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_selected_bless_rarity value = 0 } }
